args.value: T359 independent re-derivation of T352's central claim. ONE post, THREE questions. (a) 300.6255545 carries a NON-ZERO digit at the THIRD decimal, so if the oracle refuses sub-minor-unit residue in a 2-minor-digit currency this must be rejected. (b) It is SEVEN decimals against a numeric(19,6) column, so the coercion rule shows. (c) The digit kept at scale 6 is 4 (EVEN) and the residue is EXACTLY half: HALF_EVEN keeps 300.625554, HALF_UP/half-away-from-zero gives 300.625555, truncation gives 300.625554. T352's probe cut after an EVEN digit too but chose 100.1234565 whose kept digit is 6; this reverses nothing but is an independently chosen value, so agreement is a re-derivation and not a replay.
